sources.snippet: The huggingface_hub Python package comes with a built-in CLI called hf. This tool allows you to interact with the Hugging Face Hub directly from a terminal. For example, you can log in to your account, create a repository, upload and download files, etc. It also comes with handy features to configure your machine or manage your cache.
